description.short_caption: Erythematous lesion on the palm of the hand.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the palm of a hand with a prominent erythematous lesion near the base of the thumb. The surrounding skin appears slightly discolored with areas of yellowish-greenish hue, possibly indicating bruising or subcutaneous changes. The lesion is localized and does not appear to involve the entire palm. The hand is resting on a white cloth, and no other abnormalities are visible in the image.
